effects.actual_behavior: State callback goal uses source/target state and duration, flags MOVE/LOOK/JUMP or supplied no-flags overload; requiresUpdateEveryTick=true. Start sets attack state; clock11 uses CURRENT target facing to teleport four blocks behind target at GUARD current Y through virtual safe teleport. Before26 looks at target, then freezes yaw. No local server guard. Stop sets end state0, resets attack clock, blockCooldown60 and rerolls SweepType; no independent damage.

effects.actual_behavior: IAnimatedMob inheritance preserves FALL/IN_WALL rejection and animation state; no miniboss damage cap or idle heal. Before parent tick, server fallDistance>10 requests teleport: current target anchor range10, else self range25; 15 attempts at same Y, offsets in half-range. First empty candidate with nonair block below invokes virtual teleport and returns even on failure. Loaded-chunk ground search, posted EventHooks.onEnderTeleport cancellation and destination changes, collision/liquid validation with rollback, navigation stop on success and entity event46. Fall distance is not reset here. Base teleport does not add EntityUtil synchronization. AbstractChorusling target in base registerGoals is not inherited by concrete overrides lacking super; concrete registrations are preserved separately.

exclusions.reason: FlameDrifter native parent has no part allocation, part field, multipart exposure or ID propagation. Exact Part constructors have no direct calls or bootstrap references, and no subclass exists. Reviewed definition would delegate hurt to parent after own invulnerability check, but is unsaved and its spawn packet throws UnsupportedOperationException. No independent pinned instance producer.
